name: Afghanistan
description: Afghanistan from Bactria and the Buddhas of Bamiyan to the Durrani Empire, the Great Game, Soviet war, the Taliban and today.

checkpoints.name: Bactria and Kushans
checkpoints.note: Persians and Greeks ruled Bactria, the Kushans spread Buddhism, and the Buddhas of Bamiyan were carved.

checkpoints.name: Dynasties
checkpoints.note: The Ghaznavids and Ghurids raided India, and the Mongols and Timurids passed through.

checkpoints.name: Afghan kingdom
checkpoints.note: Ahmad Shah founded the Durrani Empire. Britain fought wars here in the Great Game.

checkpoints.name: Wars
checkpoints.note: The Soviet invasion began decades of war. The Taliban ruled from 1996, were driven out in 2001 and returned in 2021.
